title: Leadership in Sales & Marketing – The CMO Program
description: Embark on an 11 month learning journey in Marketing Strategy, Sales Force Management, Digital Marketing, and Price Management.

points: Aspiring CMOs aiming to advance into executive marketing roles.
Current Marketing Managers/Directors enhancing skills to move into executive positions.
Business Owners/Entrepreneurs strengthening marketing expertise to drive growth.
Senior Marketing Executives updating skills to stay current with trends.
Marketing Consultants deepening understanding of CMO-level strategies.
Product Managers integrating comprehensive marketing strategies into processes.
Brand Managers elevating skills to a strategic, executive level.
Digital Marketing Leaders expanding knowledge to encompass overall strategy and leadership.
Marketing Analysts transitioning into strategic and leadership roles.

points: 9 Terms - Marketing Strategy, Sales Force Management, Digital Marketing, and Price Management.

content.title: Is prior experience in Strategy & Leadership required for program enrollment?
content: This program is specifically crafted for seasoned professionals looking to advance their careers and expand their sectoral knowledge. It is intended for individuals with substantial industry experience.

content.title: What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: Any latest processor (i3/i5/i7) with 2.0GHz clock speed and RAM 4GB (required), 8GB(recommended).

content.title: How much time does one need to spend on a regular basis?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 11 months.

content.title: How is the XLRI's Strategy & Leadership program different?

- **Experiential Learning Structure at XLRI:** XLRI's Experiential Learning Structure bridges theory and practice, immersing students in real-world scenarios to enhance critical thinking and problem-solving skills. This approach, supported by its AACSB accreditation, ensures graduates are well-prepared to excel in dynamic business environments.

- **Pursuit of Academic Excellence at XLRI:** XLRI's unwavering commitment to academic excellence, reflected in its prestigious NIRF ranking, underscores its dedication to providing world-class education. This dedication extends beyond rankings, fostering an environment where students thrive intellectually, professionally, and personally.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: You will have access to Accredian Career Support module. This module includes comprehensive career development sessions aimed at enhancing your job profile and helping you excel in your interviews.
